children.name: text
children: Invoices should be emailed to: {InvoiceEmail}. You should include on your invoice your PO number and bank payment details.
Payment terms are 30 days from receipt of goods and invoice.

children.name: text
children: Please note that this purchase order is sent out by Decon PM (The Issuer) on behalf of {InvoiceBuyer} (The Buyer).
Payment will be made by the Buyer and not the Issuer.

The issuer is not financially liable for payments related to this purchase order. The third party named as the buyer assumes full responsibility for all payment obligations. Any disputes or issues regarding payments are to be resolved directly between the third party and the seller. The issuer shall not be held accountable for any outstanding payment matters arising from this transaction
